assumptions: counterexample refines candidate space but does not by itself prove basis incompleteness
no solution in grammar is not semantic impossibility
verifier and candidate identities frozen before evaluation
falsifier: Orion synthesis does not leave a fully-costed verified residual over CEGIS/SyGuS/incumbent parents, leaks outcome information, misclassifies grammar failure as impossibility, or bypasses typed/verifier authority gates.
hard_gate_obligations: no scientific/method authority from synthesis alone
minimal_counterexamples: CEGIS parent finds solution faster than Orion invention
all candidates fail because grammar excludes the true solution
counterexample is used after candidate grammar/verifier changes
candidate generated after seeing fresh-assurance counterexample
fluent LLM candidate bypasses typed IR
grammar expansion is performed post-outcome without a new packet
candidate passes proxy verifier but fails original target verifier
novelty_residual: Evidence-governed typed multi-representation mechanism synthesis beyond standard CEGIS/SyGuS, if a measurable residual remains after strongest formal-synthesis parents.
object_description: Proposal-only typed mechanism/formalism synthesis over a frozen candidate grammar/operator basis, refined by verifier/falsifier counterexamples and allowed to declare a grammar/basis gap rather than semantic impossibility.
oracle_or_lower_bound: In bounded synthesis worlds exhaustively enumerate the frozen grammar to distinguish NO_SOLUTION_IN_REGISTERED_GRAMMAR from search failure. A grammar miss never establishes semantic impossibility; only the bounded candidate-language claim is closed.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped synthesis/search result only; generic candidate-counterexample refinement is prior art and synthesis success does not mint scientific/theorem/method authority.
qoi: Paired verified target-solution/search utility and total synthesis cost versus strongest CEGIS/SyGuS and incumbent Orion invention parents, with exact candidate/verifier chronology and no authority escalation.
same_system_ablation: Same synthesis specifications under CEGIS, SyGuS, incumbent Orion residual invention, and exhaustive small-grammar oracle.
scope: candidate grammar/operator basis frozen before outcomes
mixed scientific evidence only in later separately registered strata

strongest_parents.justification: Direct counterexample-guided inductive synthesis parent for verifier-backed candidate search.
Strong parent where candidate syntax/grammar and semantic specification are explicit.
Current Orion typed residual-guided invention path is the in-framework parent.
Small-world oracle identifies whether a solution exists in the frozen grammar and gives search-regret ceiling.

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = context/grammar_compile + candidate_generation/search + verifier/falsifier_calls + counterexample_processing + target_verification
